字根型; TWOT - 712,713; 動詞

欽定本 - delight 39, please 14, desire 9, will 3, pleasure 3, favour 2,
     like 2, moveth 1, would 1, at all 1; 75

   2a) (Qal) 向下彎 (#伯 40:17|)
